sourceDesc.p: Vědecká knihovna v Olomouci, M II 153; catalogue vkol000759929. Source EX/M_II_153____2Y2A3I8EX0080V.TIF; SHA256 bb7dd1f20745a795e7c788727b25b6a113cc26f2516e96ba77f18486b2d33688. Supplier MD5 mismatch unresolved.

encodingDesc.p: Raw model strings preserved without Unicode normalization. Segment IDs retain physical image alignment; Small fragments, boundary segments, tables and ornament may require segmentation review. No word-level geometry or human-verified readings.

Web presentation derivative. Facsimile graphic URI resolves to the public tiled manuscript viewer, not to a standalone bitmap or the archival TIFF. Coordinates remain original image pixels; the viewer renders them through Deep Zoom WebP tiles. Original relative graphic URI(s): ../pages/80v/image.png. Source readings and measured zones remain unchanged.
